audience: grant makers, publishers and programs that collect applications and submissions in Submittable

useCases.title: See the submissions that came in this week
useCases.text: Find the project id, then list its submissions filtered by date. The list shows status, submitter, title, labels and review stage.

useCases.title: Read one applicant's answers
useCases.text: Open a submission to see its status, labels and form entries, then read the answers of one form entry. Submitter data is personal data, so share only what you need.

useCases.title: Track submissions by status or label
useCases.text: List the labels your team uses, then list the submissions with a given status or label for one project.

useCases.title: Review all answers to one form
useCases.text: List the forms of a project, then list the completed entries of one form, page by page, to compare the answers of all submitters.

useCases.title: Check who is on the review team
useCases.text: List the team members of the organization with their email, title, permission level and roles.
